nodes.label: Python ML Service
nodes.rationale: FastAPI-based service for Random Forest forecasting of pest attacks (OPT).

nodes.label: Laravel Web Application
nodes.rationale: Core backend service using Laravel 12, handling business logic, GIS data, and interfacing with the ML service.

nodes.label: Vite / React Frontend
nodes.rationale: Frontend layer using React 19 and Inertia.js, responsible for UI and GIS mapping via Leaflet.

nodes.label: MySQL Database
nodes.rationale: Shared data store for historical pest data, predictions, and model metadata.

nodes.label: ML Product Requirements
nodes.rationale: Defines the forecasting logic (Recursive Random Forest) and API specifications.

nodes.label: Performance Analysis Report
nodes.rationale: Identifies critical bottlenecks in Docker I/O, GeoJSON handling, and synchronous database calculations.

nodes.label: SIGAP-OPT Development Guide
nodes.rationale: Enforces architectural patterns like Service Layer, Form Requests, and React Component rules.

nodes.label: Docker Compose Configuration
nodes.rationale: Orchestrates the multi-container architecture including Laravel, Vite, Python ML, and MySQL.
